title: Bellarmino’s basilica-as-relic-chest is not limited to relic sites—basilicas also summon the named Patron for cult and prayer
source_text: XIX. Porro quod supra dixit Bellarminus aedes sacras erigi Sanctis, ut ornentur eorum sepulcra, & ad commoditatem illorum qui visitant Sanctorum reliquias; adeoque basilicas, quae de Sanctorum nomine vocantur, esse thecas quasdam majores, quibus minores thecae, & ipsa Sanctorum Sepulchra clauduntur; sic accipiendum non est, quasi, juxta Bellarmini mentem, non liceret aedem sacram aedificare Sancto, nisi ubi sunt ejus reliquiae: aut quasi aedes sacra non alia ratione Sancto dicata diceretur, quam quia servandis ejus reliquiis destinata est. Nam Bellarminus ipse eodem in loco mentem suam explicans, docet Basilicas erigi posse Sanctis, in hunc finem ut qui illuc conveniunt, ipso Basilicae nomine admoniti, ibi tanquam Patronum colant & deprecantur Sanctum cujus nomen praefert, & in cujus honorem & memoriam consecrata dicitur.
pass_a_gloss: Further, what Bellarmine said above—that sacred houses are erected to the Saints that their sepulchers may be adorned, and for the convenience of those who visit the Saints’ relics; and so that basilicas called by the Saints’ names are certain larger chests by which smaller chests and the Saints’ Sepulchers themselves are enclosed—is not to be so taken as if, according to Bellarmine’s mind, it were not lawful to build a sacred house to a Saint except where his relics are: or as if a sacred house were said dedicated to a Saint for no other reason than because it is destined for keeping his relics. For Bellarmine himself in the same place explaining his mind teaches that Basilicas can be erected to the Saints to this end, that those who gather there, admonished by the very name of the Basilica, may there cultivate and pray to as Patron the Saint whose name it bears, and in whose honor and memory it is said consecrated.
pass_b_english: Do not over-read Bellarmino’s relic-chest image as relic-only.
He also allows basilicas so the name itself summons worshippers to honor and pray to that Patron.

lemmas.gloss: they may cultivate and pray to as Patron

choices.english: admonished by the basilica’s very name
choices.why: Name-driven Patron cult beyond relic storage.
